```sql
SELECT
  orders.status AS "orders.status",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count",

FROM orders AS orders
GROUP BY
```

SQL:
SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  SUM(orders.amount) / COUNT(*) AS "orders.region_aov",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name
LIMIT 21

args.message: Average order value is revenue (sum of amount) divided by number of orders. Each order takes its region from its customer, and orders whose customer has no known region are grouped under null (16 orders). The company-wide average order value covers all 5,016 orders: 66.32544856459337.
